purpose: Evidence-link abstention: a supported status needs at least one cited quotation from a section linked to the condition.

rules.trigger: When identifiable_basis, chronology_integrity or reasoning_traceability would be supported, at least one cited quotation for it must sit in a linked section role (identifiable_basis: authority or basis; chronology_integrity: chronology, request, authority, decision or expiry; reasoning_traceability: basis). Otherwise the status is review_required with reason "evidence_not_in_linked_section".
rules.limitation: Section linkage is not semantic support; a linked section can still hold irrelevant text.
rules.false_positive_risk: A relevant sentence placed in an unlinked section (for example a rationale moved into residual risk, Phase 4 ST-06) is routed to review.
rules.owner_decision_for_expansion: Any widening of the trigger, any new pattern, or any change of outcome requires a recorded owner decision and a new sealed scenario set.
